So ">?100" = 100 Ns (200+100 -> qlen 300), ">?unk100" same, ">?" = Bad gap size + 1 N, ">?abc" = Bad gap size + Problem parsing + 1 N, ">?0" and ">?4294967296" = Bad gap size + 1 N, ">?5xyz" = 5 N + Problem parsing, ">?  7  " and ">?unk 5" fine, two consecutive gap lines add up (11 N), a gap at the record start (position 0) or end is allowed (g_start: qlen 210 with 10 Ns first; g_end). notes: CloseGap() is a no-op (fParseGaps unset, m_CurrentGapLength 0; CCustomizedFastaReader::x_CloseGap is an empty override for the same reason), CloseMask() closes an open run, then AssignMolType, then ParseTitle. Because fParseGaps is not set and m_TotalGapLength > 0 the gaps become runs of N (nucleotide: inst.IsAa() false) or X (protein) of the given length, inserted at the raw position recorded when the gap line was read, in file order (consecutive gap lines at the same position just add up); the sequence length counts them (qlen 300 for 100+100 residues with ">?100"; start/end gaps allowed); m_Gaps is cleared so the delta-seq branch is not used for gaps. The gap letters count as ordinary residues for the search (BLAST sees N or X) and the report. LOSAT: rejected; BLASTX builds the N/X run immediately in parse_fasta_lines.
